the upcoming Test series against South Africa citing personal reasons. The wicket-

BeardGuy: "The arrival of Marco Jansen made everyone forget how good an all-rounder 
Andile Pehlukwayo really is. He plays an unsexy utility role that never gets noticed. He 
bowls cutters in the middle overs, he can handle an additional over or two in the death 
because the captain already spent the strike bowler's quota at the start of the innings, 
and with the bat in ODIs he's a budget Dhoni. It's a pity that his best format is also the 
one that's most at risk of dying." 
12.30pm India dominate with the ball after losing the toss. It was just slightly grey in the 
morning and that's where Arshdeep picked up two wickets in the day's second over. 
After that, the onslaught of wickets never stopped with Avesh joining in the act after the 
first powerplay ended. Both bowlers were on four wickets each before Arshdeep made it 
a fifth. Kuldeep with the final one makes it curtains well before anyone at the ground 
imagined. 
 
South Africa have Phehlukwayo to thank for the score of 116. Without his 33, South 
Africa were going to be all out for a third-straight double-digit total against India in ODIs. 
Arshdeep Singh: I was under a bit of pressure because I never took any wicket in ODIs 
before. Happy to get a fifth. The wicket had purchase early on and the plan was to get 
some LBWs and bowleds. (Having the new ball) Our team's main motto is adaptibility. 
Whether I open or bowl first-change, I'm happy representing my country. (10 overs in 
first 25 overs) It was quite hot as well. I was playing a 50-over game after a year. But it 
all paid off, and after my five-for, I feel very fresh. (Shows the ball to the camera) We 
thought surface would be abrasive too but there was a bit of moisture on the surface."
